title: THE DEMO RAID HAS A 10 MINUTE CLOCK
why: His mode design of 2026-10-12 (DEMO: 10 minute raids) and his answer 7 (when the DEMO clock reaches 0 the site burns like a normal raid). A DEMO raid was endless. It now carries a 10 minute clock, shown under the score, with the normal raid warnings, and at 0 the site burns exactly as a normal raid does. A death in the burn ends the run (RUN OVER, with the score as it stood) rather than dropping the player back into the fire. The rings still never close, and a fresh raid built for a late player 2 keeps the time the run had left.
now: A DEMO raid lasts 10 minutes; at 0 the site burns and the run ends.
